verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these five grasping aggregates.
That is, the grasping aggregates of form, feeling, perception, choices, and consciousness.

verses.pali: Ye hi keci, bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā imesaṁ pañcannaṁ upādānakkhandhānaṁ assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ nappajānanti …pe…
verses.english: There are ascetics and brahmins who don’t truly understand these five grasping aggregates’ gratification, drawback, and escape …

verses.pali: pajānanti, sayaṁ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantī”ti.
verses.english: There are ascetics and brahmins who do truly understand …”
